finding: Write-store locator ambiguity and misleading recovery category
observation: Native01 passed the head-file path to commit three times and recovered using the store directory. The evaluation setup mislabeled the head file as a store. Native02 setup separates them; this does not change runtime diagnostics.
source_review: Read-only explorer inspection and CLI help; no new runtime fault reproduction. Existing path guidance specifies a directory, while immediate MCP schema and CLI positional help omit that explanation. The directory lock calls mkdir on the supplied path; the resulting uncategorized OSError is reported as unavailable_observation/restore_observation rather than a rejected write argument.
recommendation: Describe the store directory in MCP and CLI help, then reject an existing non-directory store argument before locking with a precise invalid-input diagnostic. Do not silently substitute its parent or reclassify all FileExistsError values.
scope: Narrow within-cycle follow-up; no code change, no new finding ID, no grading change and no interruption of frozen native02.
